name: @grove/sandcastle-runtime
description: Grove-owned Sandcastle workflow runtime and telemetry API

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && node -e "for (const file of ['dist/orchestrator.js', 'dist/pr-review.js', 'dist/cleanup.js', 'dist/conflict-resolver.js', 'dist/ci-fix.js', 'dist/sandcastle.js']) require('node:fs').chmodSync(file, 0o755)"
